# orion.template_source

<!-- Generated by tools/cgen.c from orion/script/template_source.cgen. Do not edit. -->

```lua
local template_source = require("orion.template_source")
```

Read-only callbacks for a native host rendering a Lua template.

Available only during script_template_render. Row handles belong to the host; row 0 is the root. Ordinary Lua pages pass their own source callbacks directly to the template plugin.

## `template_source.value(row, name)`

Resolves a field or join path.

| Argument | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `row` | integer |  |
| `name` | string |  |

Returns text or nil.

## `template_source.rows(name, parent)`

Reads child row handles for a named block.

| Argument | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |
| `parent` | integer |  |

Returns array of row handles.

## `template_source.filter(name, value)`

Runs an optional domain formatter.

| Argument | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |
| `value` | string |  |

Returns formatted text or nil.
